title: Pirate's Paralysis Protocol
narrative_script: Anomaly Log 001. The Subject is a Pirate Captain, currently scrolling a streaming menu for three hours. Biometrics indicate severe decision paralysis.
Ancient survival instincts clash with modern code. The Captain endured mutinies and storms, yet his nervous system is being hijacked by a glowing rectangle.
Human biology evolved for scarcity, not for weaponized choice overload. The Captain performs unpaid data entry for an algorithm.
Willpower cannot override a supercomputer. A structural override is required.
To quarantine the code and restore historical dopamine baselines, the Extraction Protocol is in the bio.
